title: Penumbra Ring - Wall of Ink
_note: Barrier anchor / early-dark state. The first, darkest crossing - almost no melody, just the breathing wall and your own pulse. With Coldfog, the least-resolved point in the whole score (bottom of the dawn arc). gbc 4-voice band. 60 BPM (deliberately slow/hollow, well below gbc 80 floor - accept the intentional slow-tempo warning), 4/4 felt as a slow pulse, dark D minor unresolved. 24 bars. Vesper motif WITHHELD - only its lowest root note (D) glows once per loop, a memory of a tune you can't yet reach inside the dark. lead=almost none, one lonely low pulse25 note swelling out of the drone every few bars. harmony=low evolving fog-pad, dark and slowly shifting, detuned at the edges. bass=deep pedal drone, oppressive and still. drums=sparse heartbeat, a single soft kick every two bars. Last bar = drone + dom-ish A pull hangs unresolved into the silent D-minor top.
